name: Nahian Tour & Travel Booking Solution
author: Abdullah Nahian

sections.description:
Nahian Tour & Travel Booking Solution is a booking and tour management plugin for tour operators, travel agencies, boat charters, and excursion providers.

Key Features:
* Dashboard & Telemetry: View settled revenue, balance due, passenger counts, booking totals, active departures, and recent bookings.
* Bookings Management: Create new bookings with dynamic passenger rows, emergency contacts, payment rows, tax calculations, and booking status controls, or cancel bookings to release seats.
* Trips & Itineraries: Build trips with duration, age and seat limits, cutoff times, highlights, key facts, day-by-day itineraries, multi-tier packages, inclusions and exclusions, galleries, maps, FAQs, group discounts, and extra services.
* Catalog Taxonomies: Organize Destinations, Activities, Trip Types, and Difficulty Levels with parent hierarchies, custom badge colors, descriptions, and WordPress Media Library images.
* Pricing Categories: Configure passenger rate multipliers, age groups, and a primary default pricing category.
* Customers Directory: Store traveler contact details, ID/passport numbers, emergency contacts, and view booking history and spend totals.
* Reports & Audit Log: Filter financial summaries and payment channels by date range, inspect trip performance, and review recent audit log activity.
* Settings & Coupons: Configure company details, currency symbol and ISO code, tax percentage, default deposit rate, payment options, Stripe keys, and discount coupons.
* Shortcodes: Embed trip listings, destinations, activities, booking lookup, search bar, featured deals, and booking forms on frontend pages.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nahian-tour-travel-booking-solution folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open Tour & Travel ERP in the WordPress admin menu to manage trips, bookings, catalog items, and settings.
  4. Configure your currency, tax rate, and payment settings under Tour & Travel ERP > Settings.
sections.faq:
What permissions are required to use the management workspace?

Users must have the manage_options capability (typically Administrators) to access and modify records in the Tour & Travel ERP workspace.

Can I organize destinations, activities, trip types, and difficulty levels into parent and child items?

Yes. Each taxonomy section supports selecting a parent item to group sub-items under a top-level category, region, or tier.

How do pricing category multipliers work?

Each price category defines a multiplier relative to the base rate (for example, 1.00 for base rate, 0.60 for 40% discount, or 1.25 for a 25% surcharge). Only one category can be marked as Primary at a time.

Which shortcodes are documented in the plugin?

You can review available shortcodes and their attributes inside the admin area under Tour & Travel ERP > Shortcodes, including [nttbs_trips], [nttbs_destinations], [nttbs_activities], [nttbs_booking_lookup], [nttbs_search_bar], [nttbs_featured_deals], and [nttbs_booking_form].
